images.caption: This display case in the lobby of the Walt Disney Family Museum in San Francisco is one of several cases showing hundreds of awards won by Walt Disney.  This case displays many of the Academy Awards that Disney won, including the distinctive award for Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.  The museum allows photography in its lobby, and this photograph is intended to show the types of things that visitors to the Walt Disney Family Museum can see, and to illustrate Walt Disney's accomplishments.  It is not intended to show what typical Oscar statuettes look like, and their appearance here is de minimis.
